description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer backspace/default-attribute checkpoint: safe Rust owns VT and WriteCharsLegacy printable-plus-BS behavior without legacy attribute degradation, and composes the existing DCH owner for prompt-line edits.

entries.notes: HostWriteState writes printable VT text with the complete symbolic TextAttribute and treats BS as cursor-only movement. The direct witness reproduces XX+BS, cursor x=1, non-legacy stored defaults, and the configured magenta default background resolved through ColorTableState.

The legacy entry point deliberately shares the modern attribute-preserving row writer after platform adaptation. The witness covers both Microsoft data rows: characters/control supplied singly and XX+BS supplied as one batch, with identical cursor and cell attributes.

The prompt witness composes HostWriteState cursor movement with the already migrated line_edit::delete_cells DCH owner. After XXX, cursor-left-2 and DCH at column 1, the cursor remains at x=1 and every cell retains the expected symbolic default TextAttribute, matching the Microsoft regression observable.
